question: Which of the following is **NOT** one of the three parallel ranges of the Himalayas in its longitudinal extent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himshikha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Himshikha** is **not one of the three parallel ranges of the Himalayas** in its longitudinal extent.
 
• **The three parallel ranges of the Himalayas are:**
 
 
• Himadri
 
• Himachal 
 
• Shivaliks
